column3: The Hebrew says the seventh month arrived while the Israelites were in the towns; BSB describes them as having settled there by that month.
The Hebrew says they arose and built the altar; BSB says they began to build it. The Hebrew calls both associated groups brothers; BSB says fellow priests and associates.
The Hebrew introduces their fear with “because”; BSB introduces it with “even though.” The altar’s bases are plural in Hebrew; BSB says “its foundation.”
The Hebrew twice repeats day in describing the daily offerings and their requirement; BSB gives daily offerings prescribed for each day.
The Hebrew describes each person voluntarily offering an offering; BSB refers to the offerings brought.
The Hebrew leaves the plural subject unnamed here; BSB names the Israelites.
The Hebrew says “to the sea at Joppa”; BSB says “to Joppa by sea.”
The Hebrew says “the rest of their brothers”; BSB says “the rest of their associates.”
The Hebrew describes stationing the priests with a plural causative verb; BSB describes the priests taking their positions. It uses “the hands of David” for his direction.
The Hebrew says the house of the LORD was founded; BSB says the foundation of the house of the LORD had been laid.
The Hebrew repeats “the house” and explicitly mentions their eyes; BSB calls it a temple and phrases the second sight as seeing its foundation.
The Hebrew describes the people shouting a great shout; BSB says they were making so much noise.
